open_items.item: Release workflow build for this branch
open_items.detail: The temporary arena/** push trigger used for the Task-1 release build was removed on purpose in 140e1ec. Re-adding it (or dispatching the workflow with a user token) is required to produce a signed release APK from this branch; CI already builds and uploads the debug APK.
63672.png / 63673.png / 63674.jpg / 63675.jpg / 63676.jpg were never attached to the session, so the redesign followed the locked text requirements plus the two annotated phone screenshots.
Android behaviour was verified through the WebView simulator suite (Chromium + mock bridge) and the Kotlin/CI builds; no physical device or emulator run was possible in the sandbox.

known_limitations: The long BDS sidebar search stays in the source but is disabled by default (ENABLE_LONG_SIDEBAR_SEARCH = false) - a deliberate F.3 choice, reversible with a one-line change.
Scanning/fetching unsupported file formats is unchanged from the shipped extension; no new capabilities were introduced.
Pre-existing Svelte a11y warnings elsewhere in the codebase were left as-is; the three new warnings introduced by PluginsSettings were fixed.
